title: feat(manual-card-authoring): manual flashcard creation (S-02)
body:
## Why

Roadmap **S-02** / PRD **FR-005**: give users a way to create a flashcard by hand (question + answer) and save it to their deck. This is the fallback path for when AI generation (S-01) doesn't fit the source material. It builds on F-01 (per-user store + RLS) and reuses S-01's Zod schemas and page/island patterns.

## What

- New `POST /api/flashcards/manual` — auth via session `getUser()`, validates one card with the reused `candidateSchema`, inserts `source:'manual'` with a session-derived `user_id` under RLS, returns `{saved:1}`. Deliberately separate from the AI batch-save endpoint so the north-star wedge code stays untouched.
- `ManualCardForm` React island + protected `/create` page (mirrors `/generate`); `/create` added to middleware `PROTECTED_ROUTES`; dashboard links to it.
- Inline confirmation + form reset on save; empty/over-length fields disable save; typed error codes → friendly copy.
- No DB migration — the `flashcards.source` column (default `'manual'`, CHECK `in ('ai','manual')`) already exists from F-01.

## How to verify

- **Automated (CI mirror):** `npx astro sync` → `npm run lint` → `npm run build` — all pass.
- **Manual (verified locally):**
  - `/create` signed out → redirects to `/auth/signin`.
  - Signed-in save → `200 {"saved":1}`; row persists with `source='manual'` + caller's `user_id` (confirmed via RLS-scoped read).
  - Unauth → 401; empty/over-length input → 400 `invalid_input` (rejected rows write nothing).
  - Browser (Playwright): save shows confirmation + clears form; empty fields disable the button; dashboard link navigates; `/generate` unregressed.

## Risk & rollback

- **Low.** Additive only — one new endpoint, one new page, one island; no change to the AI path, no schema/migration. Guardrails held: `user_id` is session-derived (never body), RLS `with check` pins ownership, `source='manual'` keeps the "75%-via-AI" metric honest.
- Rollback: revert the branch; nothing to migrate.
- Full-plan impl-review: **APPROVED** (0 critical, 0 warnings, 2 accepted observations).

## Refs

Roadmap S-02 · PRD FR-005
